name: How do I prioritize home repairs when preparing my house for sale on a budget?

mainEntity.name: How do I prioritize home repairs when preparing my house for sale on a budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritize essential repairs first, such as fixing safety hazards, addressing structural issues, or resolving active leaks. Next, focus on cosmetic updates that offer a high visual impact without extensive cost, like painting, decluttering, and minor landscaping. Consider potential buyer feedback and focus on areas that appear dated or neglected. City Dweller, LLC can help you create a cost-effective plan, ensuring your budget is spent on improvements that matter most to buyers in the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize essential repairs and safety issues first, then focus on high-impact cosmetic updates like painting and decluttering to maximize value on a budget.
